caption: Example Extension Attribute Dictionary
description: Attributes contributed by the example extension. Extension attributes are namespaced by the extension name unless they are declared in the core dictionary.
name: dictionary

example_endpoint.caption: Example Endpoint
example_endpoint.description: URL of the endpoint that the example telemetry module reports to.

example_sample_rate.caption: Example Sample Rate
example_sample_rate.description: Percentage of events reported by the example telemetry module, from 0 to 100.

example_telemetry_data.caption: Data
example_telemetry_data.description: Telemetry configuration supported by the agent. Module payload objects are self-typed in the dictionary so that the module's data attribute resolves to the object rather than to a string.
